name: agent-relay
description: Delegate build work from Claude to OpenCode and Command Code agents through a local bridge, and follow their tasks.

bridgePath.title: Bridge entry point
bridgePath.description: Absolute path of the agent relay bridge's main.ts, started with node for each session.

nodePath.title: Node executable
nodePath.description: The node that runs the bridge: node from PATH by default, or an absolute path such as C:/Program Files/nodejs/node.exe.
